dct_title_s: Johnson County, Iowa, 1937, aerial photomosaic index
dct_description_sm: Title supplied by cataloger based on information from sheet labels. Images are photoreductions of mosaics created from original aerial photographs. Designating symbol SY; form of individual image numbering: SY-1-[number], SY-2-[number], SY-3-[number], SY-4-[number], or SY-5-[number]. "Date of completion 10-23-37". Flown by Gatschet Aerial Surveys, Des Moines, Iowa. "Approximate scale, 1:20,000" [refers to individual images from which mosaic was made]. Library's copy 2 consists of photographic negatives (4 x 5 in.) corresponding to each of the images in its copy 1.
